method: This matrix records claims exercised by existing user-visible Playwright journeys and selected screenshots. It does not claim pixel equality with the mock or physical-device behavior. A page is listed as automated PASS only for the behavior actually covered by the cited evidence.

integratedSurfaceTraceability.claim: Permission, loading, ready, recording, processing, review and recoverable-error behavior is integrated into text panels; physical PC/Android/iPhone speech remains a release check.
The visible journey seeds the 0.1.0 fixture, edits the week, adds CT, exercises all 13 sessions, closes/reopens and checks the original rows and note; the final full E2E gate must still be recorded.

intentionalDifferencesFromMock: The mock is a frozen composition target. Live data, names, counts and warning states are deterministic fixture content rather than pixel-identical mock copy.
On first-launch P02, the live app omits a back control because there is no valid predecessor.
Where supplied boat-image provenance does not permit production use, the live app uses a same-size model mark. The boat identity and number remain visible.
